React Essentials

learnings/React/docs/react-tutorial.html

Components, props, state, effects, hooks, context, routing with React Router, auth with a protected route, styling, and turning a Figma file into components.

Python learning path

Five tutorials on the parts of Python that take longest to click. Each idea is built up one small step at a time, and every example was run before it was published.

Python learning path

Python Design

Two tutorials built on one small bank. Every example is a few lines long, runs with only the standard library, and reuses the same Person and Account classes.

Step 1

Design Principles

learnings/Python/docs/design-principles.html

The five SOLID principles, then six general ones: DRY, KISS, YAGNI, composition over inheritance, tell don't ask and encapsulation. Each one shown as the code that breaks it, then the fix.

  • Single responsibility
  • Open/closed
  • Liskov substitution
  • Interface segregation
  • Dependency inversion
  • DRY: don't repeat yourself
  • KISS: keep it simple

Step 2

Design Patterns

learnings/Python/docs/design-patterns.html

All 23 classic patterns, grouped into creational, structural and behavioural, with what each family means. Every pattern has the problem it solves, a small example and the shortcut Python gives you.

  • Creational patterns
  • Structural patterns
  • Behavioural patterns
